question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Obsequious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Assertive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Obsequious"** means excessively obedient or attentive to an excessive degree, often to gain favor or approval. (चापलूस)
 
 
• **Example: **The employee's obsequious behavior annoyed his colleagues as he constantly flattered his boss.
 
 
• **"Assertive"** refers to having a confident and forceful personality, expressing opinions or desires in a firm and respectful way, without being submissive. (आत्मविश्वासी)
 
 
• **Example: **She was assertive during the meeting and presented her ideas confidently.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Obsequious'** is **'Assertive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Assertive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Submissive** (आज्ञाकारी): Willing to obey someone without arguing or questioning.
 
 
• **Example: **He has a submissive attitude towards his authority figures, rarely questioning their decisions.
 
 
 
• **Flattering** (चापलूसी): Complimenting someone excessively, often to gain their favor.
 
 
• **Example: **The salesperson's flattering comments convinced her to buy the product.
 
 
 
• **Senile** (वृद्ध या बूढ़ा): Showing a decline in mental faculties due to old age.
 
 
• **Example: **The senile man often forgot where he had kept his belongings.
